, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Oz the Great and Powerful was released first, despite the gathered evidence showing Sacred Planet was released on April 22, 2004, and Oz the Great and Powerful premiered on February 13, 2013. This is a straightforward chronological comparison error (2004 precedes 2013).
